description: Where can I study this? A match-up, not a dump: for a major and a level, the schools that award it, ranked by how many of the person's own criteria each one meets, with met, not met and not testable kept as three different results — a school that does not publish a fact is not testable on it, never failed. Each criterion names the source that decided it, each school carries its own program, award, credits required, cost, earnings, debt and whether it can be done online, and a filter only ever excludes on a fact we hold. The answer states its ranking rule and never recommends a school. TODAY the candidate set is the schools CourseShelf has captured a program for, not yet every school IPEDS lists, and every answer opens by saying so.

also_offers.description: Optional other subjects or majors the school should also offer

award.description: Optional award title or credential class

cost_max.description: Optional: the most the person will pay. A school that publishes no cost is not removed by it — it is ranked below and marked not testable on cost

delivery.description: Optional: in person, hybrid or online

exclude_untestable.description: Optional strict exclusion, off by default: remove schools that do not publish one of the criteria. The answer then says how many were removed and by which criterion

level.description: The credential level, e.g. certificate, associate or bachelor's

major.description: The major: a major_minor_id (e.g. CIP:51.3801) or a CIP code

near.description: Optional: a place and a distance, e.g. Casper WY within 50 miles

offset.description: Optional: the offset of the next page

sector.description: Optional school type as IPEDS labels it, e.g. public 2-year

state.description: Optional two-letter state. With no state, city or place the answer is national and says so

with_checklist.description: Optional: only schools whose requirements CourseShelf holds

name: find_my_school

candidate_set.description: Where the schools came from and why it is not yet IPEDS's list

measure_not_met.description: The measure this build does not yet meet, named in the answer

schools.description: One row per school: its program with the route that joined it to the major, cost, earnings and debt, its programs that could not be joined, and its standing — every criterion with its verdict and source

scope.description: Said when the answer is national because no place was given

statement.description: What the candidate set is, as the first thing the person reads

strict_exclusion.description: Present only when exclude_untestable was asked for: how many schools were removed, by which criterion

title: Find My School
